chars.NEIGHBOUR: NEIGHBOUR: a bald middle-aged Moroccan man with a thick grey moustache, wearing a maroon robe over blue-and-white striped pyjamas and plastic slippers
chars.POLICEMAN: POLICEMAN: a Moroccan police officer in a dark navy uniform jacket over a light blue shirt and a navy peaked cap
chars.IMAD: IMAD: a young Moroccan man with curly black hair, wearing a bright yellow hoodie and black joggers
chars.ABDEL: ABDEL: a young Moroccan man with a short fade haircut and a thin beard, wearing an olive green bomber jacket over a white t-shirt
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young Moroccan woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing a red satin top, black jeans and gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, apartment building stairwell in Bouskoura, Morocco. Seen from the stairs: the NEIGHBOUR stands at a closed apartment door, pointing at it angrily and talking to the POLICEMAN, wide-eyed, insisting. Head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, dim yellow stairwell light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, apartment stairwell in a Moroccan building: several sleepy neighbours in pyjamas and robes crowd on the stairs and landings, peeking out of their doors, curious and whispering; the NEIGHBOUR in front, arms crossed, satisfied. Comic mood.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, in front of a closed wooden apartment door in a Moroccan building: the POLICEMAN bangs on the door with his fist, shouting, frowning, flashlight in his other hand.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Dark small bedroom in a Moroccan apartment at night, light from the hallway under the door: IMAD, ABDEL and the GIRL crouch behind the bed, frozen, holding their breath, IMAD with a finger on his lips, all wide-eyed and scared. Slightly comic.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Dark bedroom in a Moroccan apartment, a phone screen shows 3:00 in the night: IMAD and ABDEL sit on the floor against the wall, exhausted, whispering to each other nervously, faces lit by the phone.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Dim apartment hallway in Morocco before dawn: IMAD presses his ear against the front door, listening, while the GIRL stands behind him clutching her handbag, anxious.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Early morning blue light through a window of a Moroccan apartment, a wall clock shows 5:30: IMAD and ABDEL whisper urgently, making a plan with hand gestures, tense but funny.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment building stairwell at dawn, blue light: IMAD leads the GIRL down the stairs on tiptoe, both barefoot holding their shoes, glancing nervously at a neighbour's closed door with a peephole.
